definitions.ask: Should the Links stage admit only Event Tasks from daily notes?
definitions.why: Event Tasks are what was asked for; other daily-note tasks add hundreds of look-alike rows.

choices.label: Only `## Events` rows led by `**HHMM-HHMM**` join; `^gtd` rows and old ledger tasks stay out
Every daily-note task joins, like Mac Capture's `~` catalog, adding a `^gtd` row per day

definitions.ask: Should Event Tasks from every past day be linkable?
definitions.why: Relations are history and capture `~` reaches any day; newest-first ranking sinks old rows.

choices.label: Every daily note's Event Tasks join; equal-score rows rank newest day first
Only today, future days, and the last 30 days join; older meetings need a hand-written link

definitions.ask: Should LINKS and LINKED FROM chips also name Event Tasks as `HHMM-HHMM Title`?
definitions.why: Otherwise every new meeting link shows the raw gcal link markdown seen in the screencast.

choices.label: Chips drop the 📅/📹/📍 link markdown and fields, matching the Links stage rows
Chips keep their current text, such as `1100-1130 Phone Call w/ Dan [📅](https:/…`
